text:
A fixed mass of gas has a volume of 25cm3. The pressure of the gas is 100kPa.
The volume of the gas is slowly decreased by 15cm3 at constant temperature.
What is the change in pressure of the gas?
A
67kPa
B
150kPa
C
170kPa
D
250kPa
subject: Physics
